questions.q: What does « passer un examen » mean?
questions.why: False friend: passer = sit; réussir = pass.

questions.q: « Il est huit heures moins le quart. » What time is it?
questions.why: Moins le quart = a quarter to, so a quarter to eight.

questions.q: How do you say 'I play the piano'?
questions.why: Instruments take jouer de (du piano); sports take jouer à (au foot).

questions.q: Translate into French: I have a sore throat.
